scope.description: Closed-form calculations for the independent-audit model in paper/main.tex; not a repeated-game or network-security proof.
assumptions: Fabricated reports remain below the audit threshold.
Each eligible audit is an independent Bernoulli trial.
One slash excludes a node only when U_t = 1 and gamma > alpha - tau_excl.

theorem_2_expected_score_gap.interpretation: Positive only for the stated low-quality-fabricator audit model.

theorem_3_one_shot_maximizer.interpretation: The score-only, one-shot objective is maximized at A=1; this is not a repeated-game Nash equilibrium or proof that an implementation can measure true accuracy.
